newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK police plan to charge five for blaze murders.
newsitem.headline: HK police plan to charge five for blaze murders.

text.p: Hong Kong police plan to charge five suspects with murder in connection with a karaoke bar blaze in which 15 people were killed last weekend, Hong Kong government radio said on Monday, quoting police.

The blaze in the Top One karaoke night club in Hong Kong's Tsimshatsui nightlife district was suspected of being caused by a petrol bomb in a turf war between rival "triad" crime gangs, who compete for protection racket money.

The police anti-triad bureau said on Monday three men and two women were likely to appear in court on Tuesday charged with murder. They were among a group of alleged members of the Sun Yee On triad group arrested in connection with the fire.
The suspects facing murder charges were not named.
Five of 15 other victims injured in the blaze remained in hospital on Monday, with two in critical condition.
